title: Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road

waypoints.name: Kabale
waypoints.advice: Kabale is where the day begins. Next is Lake Bunyonyi, 37 km on.

waypoints.name: Lake Bunyonyi
waypoints.advice: Lake Bunyonyi comes up 37 km in. Next is Kisoro, 37 km on.

waypoints.name: Kisoro
waypoints.advice: 74 km in you reach Kisoro. Next is Bwindi, 37 km on.

sections.advice: Kabale → Lake Bunyonyi is 10 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Lake Bunyonyi → Kisoro is 34 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Kisoro → Bwindi is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 15 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 47 km this is Uganda Kigezi Highlands Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

story: 111 km round from Kabale - plan on about 1 h 54 of riding. The stops in between: Lake Bunyonyi and Kisoro. The highest point is about 2,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
